notes:
Prospect background: Wardencrest operates regional industrial telemetry and control networks for potable-water treatment plants across 6 states. They are a government-contracted operator with classified-ish enclave requirements for ML workloads. Key quote from CISO: "We cannot allow any egress unless explicitly approved — offline updates only."

CRM-style summary / shorthand: 
- Primary contact: Theresa Byrd (CISO) / secondary: Marcus Flynn (OT lead)
- Procurement lead: GSA-contracted purchasing lane, 30–60 day legal review window.
- Wants an air-gapped Private deployment on their co-lo cages; minimal external callouts; HSM-backed keys required for model signing and audit stamps.
- Evaluating Redwood Private vs Infratech OnPremAI — Redwood wins on runtime perf but must prove offline deployment/update model.

Technical requirements (from OT workshop):
- No outbound internet from inference nodes; maintenance via signed USB image or internal repo mirrored across DMZ.
- Support for quantized LLMs (4-bit prefer) for constrained GPU footprint; runtime must support model verification at boot using customer HSM.
- Latency SLOs: 95th p50 < 120ms for short-chat (<=128 tokens) for operator assist flows; batch reranking throughput target 500 qps for nightly ingest windows (can be scheduled).
- Data residency: telemetry and prompt logs must remain in local SIEM for 7 years; audit logs > immutable retention.
- Integration asks: Splunk/SIEM export, PKI/HSM APIs, offline licensing mechanism, signed SBOM, and CVE patch cadence documentation.

POC ask: 12-week air-gapped pilot — 2 x A100-equivalent nodes with dedicated NVMe for KV cache, on-prem control plane VM in separate management VLAN. Acceptance criteria: offline install, HSM key attestation, p99 latency within threshold, audit log validation.

Sales notes: 
- AE (Maya) to lead pricing + SOW; SE (Connor) to scope install-runbook and provide golden-image checklist; CSM (Sana) will be pre-assigned for onboarding if POC clears security.
- Short-term win: provide a documented offline-update flow + signed sample model artifact and boot verification demo.

use_case_summary: Primary: operator assistance chat + incident summarization for control-room staff; secondary: nightly reranking of sensor feeds and anomaly triage. Must be run in offline, air-gapped Private mode with strong audit controls.
latency_throughput_targets: 95th percentile <120ms (chat, <=128 tokens); batch reranking 500 qps during scheduled windows; cost sensitivity moderate — TCO important but security > cost.
model_preferences: Prefer open/quantizable models (Llama2-like, MPT variants) that can be shipped as signed artifacts. No blackbox cloud models. Preference for Redwood-verified runtime + quantization profiles.
routing_fallback_needs: Local fallback to smaller quantized variant if memory pressure; no cross-region fallback allowed due to air-gap. Prefer in-cluster circuit-breaker and graceful degradation to cached responses.
additional_notes: Legal asked for proof of SOC2-like controls for the Private installer; suggested providing high-level SOC2 mapping and engineering checklist. POC budget tentatively approved pending SOW and security sign-off.
